tools.name: investigate_get-recommendations-name
tools.description: List the co-occurences for the specified domain. A co-occurrence is when two or more domains are accessed by the same users within a small window of time. Co-occurring domains are not necessarily problematic; legitimate sites co-occur with each other as a part of normal web activity. params.name: virtualApplianceId
params.description: The origin ID (originId) of the virtual appliance.

params.name: siteId
params.description: The ID of the site.

novel_features.name: Domain verdict
novel_features.description: One answer for a domain: category, risk score, security status, every destination list that blocks or allows it (including parent-domain entries), and who resolved it recently.

novel_features.name: List vs file diff
novel_features.description: Reconcile a destination list against a source-of-truth file: see what to add and remove, then apply it in API-sized chunks. --apply also removes entries absent from the file unless --no-remove.

novel_features.name: Fleet health rollup
novel_features.description: One row per managed customer: seats, an issues count, and counts of off, uninstalled, stale, and SWG-unprotected roaming computers, unhealthy virtual appliances, and down tunnels. Customers that fail are listed under fetch_failures.

novel_features.name: Deployment hygiene
novel_features.description: Device-level findings in one org: stale or offline roaming computers, unhealthy virtual appliances, down tunnels, and unverified networks, each tagged with a kind.

novel_features.name: Customer report card
novel_features.description: A customer's security summary, top threat types, blocked categories, and deployment status for a window, compared with the prior window. --csv emits the summary rows only.

novel_features.name: Allow-list audit
novel_features.description: Find allow-list entries that are now categorized as malicious, entries that conflict with a block list, and allows added in a recent window.
